answer: The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The delta is that a hundred names need a hundred tolls, and the farm holds only one purse. The desk takes a 10-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. A name without Deputised compositor registration with compositors standing is turned away at the counter, and a registration compositors keep after type audits is the reason the counter can tell. Every beacon is counted once. One ember, one entry.
